title: Da Buddha Vaporizer with Carrying Bag
description:
A Truly Classic Vaporizer

One of the first desktop vaporizers and still one of the best
Simple and easy to use, glass on glass, good tasty vapor

Made from high quality materials, the housing is solid aluminum. The housing goes through a pain staking process of cutting, drilling, grinding, filling, sanding, sand blasting and then it’s anodized to get a nice finish. The Buddha uses a high quality ceramic heater and the temperature is fully adjustable. To make a perfect seal every Da Buddha uses a ground glass joint also giving the user the hands free experience.

Included in the Kit:
Borosilicate glass heater cover and aluminum knob
Standard whip (includes standard PYREX quick change wand and food grade vinyl tube)
Padded Storage Bag made of durable hemp and polyester blend “hempster”
Hand made glass marble stainless steel pick (Marble End is hand made so it may not fit inside the wand)
Instruction manual
3 year manufacturer warranty

BONUS ITEM: Storz Acrylic Hand Grinder

7th Floor has been in business for many years, they make durable vaporizers. Parts are readily available and in stock.
